User Story: As an agent handed the repo URL I follow AGENTS.md and load one matching skill
Expected Behaviour: AGENTS.md classifies use/install/edit/review; first matching map row; no-skill row exists; cwd rule distinguishes library vs product
Edge Cases: Unfamiliar+review collision; two jobs; using skill on product repo
Notes: Map puts review and quality-loop above learn-codebase

User Story: As a person I install from README or QUICKSTART
Expected Behaviour: Commands are npx skills add Thingscorp/skills with --list/-y --skill --all; no install.sh
Edge Cases: User runs ./tools/install.sh; gh skill vs npx

User Story: As a user I list exported skills without installing
Expected Behaviour: npx skills add Thingscorp/skills --list -y prints 15 names
Notes: Waived live rerun this pass; last run in prior session listed 15

User Story: As an agent I load skills/<name>/SKILL.md
Expected Behaviour: 15 folders each with SKILL.md; name matches folder

User Story: As a catalog indexer I parse name+description; portability under metadata
Expected Behaviour: name kebab=folder; description contains use this when; portability not top-level
Edge Cases: Unknown top-level keys rejected by strict parsers
Notes: learn-codebase grill-execute-clear to-spec kill-context-bloat steering-push-vs-point still top-level portability

User Story: As an installer I get the same 15 names everywhere
Expected Behaviour: plugin.json marketplace.json skills.sh.json AGENTS README llms.txt list the same 15
Edge Cases: New skill forgotten in one catalog

User Story: As a maintainer I run python3 tools/validate.py
Expected Behaviour: Exit 0 when catalogs+landmines+names hold; exit 1 on drift
Notes: Does not yet reject top-level portability

User Story: As a reviewer I see validate.yml on push/PR
As a later agent I read docs/adr for binding calls
Expected Behaviour: NNNN-slug.md; Nygard status; no number collision

User Story: As a drafter I cannot soften pinned claims
Expected Behaviour: Phrases in LANDMINES appear in some SKILL.md; validator checks them
Edge Cases: Phrase only in docs not skills
Notes: Validator phrase list is the executable contract

User Story: As an agent I review a named plan or diff
Expected Behaviour: BLOCKED on missing scope; empty report valid; ADR capture test
Notes: AGENTS now routes product audit to quality-loop

User Story: As an agent I inventory a shipped product from code
Expected Behaviour: Discover from implementation not docs; one spreadsheet
Notes: This run is the skill applied to itself

User Story: As an agent I do not follow files that do not exist
Expected Behaviour: install.sh HARNESS-MATRIX CONFIG-SCHEMA absent; docs say so
Edge Cases: Stale cite in a skill body
Notes: session-hygiene and compact now say the matrix does not exist

Expected Behaviour: Page exists after real npx skills add telemetry
